portal.guideSubtitle: How the Quantum Technology platform works, step by step.
portal.guide1Body: Everything starts in the form on the main page. Describe your project — type, problem you want to solve, target audience, desired features, budget and timeline. Our AI analyzes the briefing and automatically calculates a complexity score, estimated hours and similar projects already delivered by the team.
portal.guide2Body: Based on the generated technical scope, the team prepares a detailed proposal with hours, costs and terms. You can review the proposal, leave comments on specific paragraphs or request an AI-assisted rewrite. When you agree, approve to move forward.
portal.guide3Body: In addition to briefings, you can create direct requests — for a new feature, bug fix, technical support or new project. Each request has a dedicated message channel for real-time communication with the team.
portal.guide4BodyStart: When the proposal is approved, a payment session is generated via Stripe. You can pay securely by credit or debit card. After confirmation, the order is automatically moved to
portal.guide4BodyEnd: and you receive a digital invoice available for download.
portal.guide5BodyStart: When the work is delivered, the order is marked as
portal.guide5BodyEnd: . At that point you can leave a 1 to 5 star rating with an optional comment. Feedback is used by the team to continuously improve the service.
